product.name: Monoprice Unity 200-Watt Bridgeable Power Amp
product.description: Monoprice™Unity 200-Watt Bridgeable Power AmpEfficient, Versatile Class-D Amplification for Business and Home Audio SystemsThe Monoprice Unity 200-Watt Bridgeable Power Amp delivers high-performance audio amplification tailored for multiroom sound systems in both residential and commercial settings. Built for flexibility and power, this Class D amplifier is the ideal choice for users seeking a customizable alternative to standard all-in-one audio solutions.Supporting 4-ohm and 8-ohm speaker configurations, it delivers up to 125 watts per channel or 225 watts in bridged mode. A buffered loop line output allows seamless expansion to additional amplifiers, while multiple power-on modes—always-on, signal detection, and trigger activation—offer versatile control.
